'''2001 Minnesota State Championship warm-up tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament on 11 May 2001. [[Joshua Grace]] won it. It is known from Joshua Grace's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2307">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-14-graces-mn-states-reportd2307/ graces-mn-states-report], DeckTech (Joshua "Stormcrow" Grace, 14 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-14-graces-mn-states-reportd2307/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[2001 Minnesota State Championship]].

* '''Date:''' 11 May 2001
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Joshua Grace]]
